SQL Formatter

Format messy SQL: keywords uppercased, clauses on new lines, and subqueries indented properly.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your SQL query.
  2. Click Format SQL.
  3. Copy the formatted query.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are strings and comments preserved?

Yes — single-quoted, double-quoted, and backtick strings plus -- and /* */ comments are preserved untouched.

Which clauses get their own line?

SELECT, FROM, WHERE, JOINs, ON, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, HAVING, LIMIT, UNION, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and more.

How are subqueries handled?

Subqueries in parentheses are indented one extra level automatically.

Does it validate SQL?

It is a formatter, not a validator — it will not catch SQL syntax errors.
